stories.title: DragonForce brings the theatrics and soaring solos to Charlotte
stories.summary: DragonForce played at The Fillmore on Tuesday, celebrating the 20th anniversary of "Inhuman Rampage." Ensiferum and Rhapsody of Fire supported them.

stories.title: How to save money this holiday shopping season
stories.summary: The biggest piece of advice: make a budget and stick to it.

stories.title: Weather Alert: Widespread rain, gusty winds to impact Thanksgiving in the Carolinas
stories.summary: It's going to be a cold, windy and wet Thanksgiving across the Charlotte area, with weather impacting travel and holiday events.

stories.title: The weather isn't great tonight, but travel impacts are low.
stories.summary: A strong coastal storm is hitting the Carolinas this Thanksgiving Eve, bringing rain and gusty winds that are affecting travel. Expect clearer skies Thursday.

stories.title: Gastonia K-9 tracks toddler, suspect after domestic violence dispute
stories.summary: Bo and Sgt. Rowland were called to a Gastonia home when a a domestic assault call turned into the suspect taking the toddler from their home.

stories.title: 3 hurt in rollover crash into embankment off I-485 in north Charlotte
stories.summary: Three people were taken to the hospital after a rollover crash trapped them inside, Long Creek FD said.

stories.title: Charlotte nonprofit loses $4.6M in state funding as North Carolina charitable giving drops
stories.summary: Camino, which provides health care and other services to Latino families in the area, learned recently about the cut.

stories.title: Crews work to lift tractor-trailer hanging off embankment on Monroe Expressway
stories.summary: The incident has reduced the Monroe Expressway to one lane in the area.

stories.title: Suspect sought after 59-year-old mother killed in Charlotte hit-and-run
stories.summary: A family's holiday spirit is shattered as Charnya Dennis mourns her mother, Ada, killed in a hit-and-run, according to Charlotte police.

stories.title: Gastonia, Gaston County to open warming center during extreme cold this winter
stories.summary: The warming center will operate at City Church's Unity Campus, located at 482 N. Myrtle School Road in Gastonia

stories.title: Woman says she was ripped out of home, arrested after flashing headlights to warn drivers about police
stories.summary: Brown says the encounter escalated when an officer approached her at her Lowell home and now she's questioning whether the officer's actions were justified.

stories.title: Father charged after student accidentally brings gun to Union County elementary school
stories.summary: Investigators determined the student accidentally took her father's book bag to school. The bag contained a firearm.
